hypothesis: Message-announced displayed size pressure predicts a two-second same-direction spot repricing beyond quoted bid/ask spread. Repeated IDs mean renewed announcements, not independent new orders. No full-depth initialization or executed-flow inference.
selection: SpotCrude authenticated identity, feasible previously observed minimum margin, existing VIEW spot/depth route; no directional return selection. Not a restriction of the 1576-instrument universe.
feature: Exclude first depth message; five-second warmup; all valid newQuotes announcements in trailing inclusive1000ms; at least10items and BOTH sides; bid-size>=3ask-size BUY, vice versa SELL. Deletions retained but not signed trades. Duplicate IDs within one message or invalid side/price/size clears feature and censors pending episode.
exposure: Initial spot snapshot excluded; subsequent explicit BID and ASK required; positive spread, local and server side ages<=5000ms; missing/reversed/future clocks, locked/crossed or stale state censors whole episode. No future endpoint healing or favorable censor deletion.
execution: One pending episode only. First healthy spot250..1000ms after decision; BUY ASK/SELL BID. First healthy spot2000..2500ms after entry, opposite liquidation side. Fixed5000ms cooldown from decision. Censor timeout/invalid path/terminal pending; retain every decision, episode and censor.
costs: Pre-account necessary quoted-headroom screen only. Gross is signed RAW PRICE DIFFERENCE, not USD/EUR, CFD PnL or capital return; no contract multiplier guessed. Spread is included by sides. Current native commission/minimum, volume and margin are captured, never backdated. Nonspread costs/slippage/funding/conversion/firm fills unresolved, never zero. No net claim or funded account; one continuous EUR200 remains downstream requirement.
budget: One new dependent DEVELOPMENT identity, one attempt/contact, at most one model outcome; no retune, retry, refund, confirmation or automatic followup. V2/C033 accounting not rewritten.
privacy: Raw market/meta/account and all economic numbers encrypted to existing recipient. Public source counts, exact hashes, boolean gates, disposition only. Separate custody export and result readback; preserve original source/result ciphertext and actual evaluator DLL.
